next_step: POC: hosted API latency SLO tests + tool-calling demo scheduled 2026-03-18
notes:
Lead: Head of Product (Alyssa Chen) + CTO (Ravi Menon). Target: outbound SDR chat agents that can perform CRM/email/calendar actions via tool-calling; replace manual SDR steps for new-user outreach. Currently evaluating Hosted API for fast rollout; leaning to Dedicated after traffic stabilizes (predictable throughput).

Key technical requirements: streaming start latency <300ms (first-byte), p95 end-to-end turn <800ms, per-token append ~50-80ms; ability to stream partial responses to client UI. Must support tool-calling webhooks to Salesforce/Gmail/Calendar with secure signing and retry semantics. KV/prefix caching desirable to reduce token cost for repeated templates.

Security/compliance: require SSO/SAML, audit logging for tool calls, KMS integration for any PII, retention controls (retain logs for 90 days), potential data residency constraint for EU customers. Procurement asked for SOC2 report before Dedicated contract.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; acceptable ARR range $50k-$150k for pilot-to-prod ramp. Concerned about unit token costs at high outbound volume (10k-50k messages/month) and burst capacity for peak outreach.

POC plan: hosted API proof-of-concept first — integrate streaming + tool-calling in staging SFDC org, run 48h synthetic traffic to measure p95 latency and streaming coverage. If SLOs hit and pricing acceptable, move to Dedicated pilot (reserved pool) with canary rollout and fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained.

Quotes/voice notes: "We need the agent to actually hit Salesforce and schedule follow-ups — not just talk about it." IT: "Send SAML metadata and SOC2 ASAP." AE notes: follow up with pricing scenarios (monthly vs committed) and a sample SLA for latency.

Short-term next: scheduled POC kickoff 2026-03-18 (demo + sandbox creds), Maya to deliver SAML checklist and replay of streaming demo.

Longer-term asks: routing policy for region affinity, built-in cost analytics per-route, and suggestion for quantization profile if we self-host later.
